name: Jim Jam Biscuits
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar (24%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm) and Interesterified Vegetable Fat, Invert Sugar Syrup, Dextrose, Milk Solids (0.9%), Edible Starch (Maize), Maltodextrin, Fruit Products (2.7%), Iodised Salt, Emulsifiers (Soya Lecithin [322], 471, 481[i]), Raising Agents (500[ii], 503[ii]), Gelling Agent (440), Acidity Regulators (330, 331[i]). Contains Added Flavours (Artificial Flavoring Substances - Mixed Fruit, Butter and Vanilla).
